import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    p = [0] + [int(x) for x in data[2:2 + n]]
    visited = [False] * (n + 1)
    res = [0] * (n + 1)
    for s in range(1, n + 1):
        if visited[s]:
            continue
        cyc = []
        x = s
        while not visited[x]:
            visited[x] = True
            cyc.append(x)
            x = p[x]
        L = len(cyc)
        e = pow(2, k, L)
        for t in range(L):
            res[cyc[t]] = cyc[(t + e) % L]
    sys.stdout.write(" ".join(map(str, res[1:])) + "\n")

        sh = k % L

    k = int(data[1])
    p = [0] + [int(x) for x in data[2:2 + n]]
    result = [0] * (n + 1)
    visited = [False] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        if visited[i]:
            continue
        cycle = []
        j = i
        while not visited[j]:
            visited[j] = True
            cycle.append(j)
            j = p[j]
        L = len(cycle)
        m = pow(2, k, L)
        for idx in range(L):
            result[cycle[idx]] = cycle[(idx + m) % L]
    sys.stdout.write(" ".join(str(result[i]) for i in range(1, n + 1)) + "\n")
